digest.component_or_area: ticket creation/editing with plan-review admission guard
propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be displayed at save time (create or edit) stating length, cap, and that claim review will refuse admission until shortened.
The warning must be emitted on three surfaces: CLI via stderr, library via rebar logger, and MCP via result field (description_warning on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut).
The save-time warning must reuse the same config key and gate-enablement probe (_plan_review_gate_applies) as the existing review guard, ensuring single-sourcing and no false promises.
No warning is shown when the gate is disabled, the description is within cap, or the ticket type is exempt; the warning never blocks or alters the write.
The warning mechanism must degrade to None on any error and be computed after the CREATE/EDIT event is appended, guaranteeing that unexpected failures cannot affect the ticket persist.
